title: First run
subtitle: Zero to a working tunnel, target under two minutes

admin.showOnce: Shown once — copy it now. It is also written to initial-admin-password in the data dir with mode 0600.
admin.empty: Username and password are both required
admin.rejectWeak: Empty credentials and admin/admin-style defaults are refused.

address.stunNote: Detected via STUN. Confirm that this is the address the outside world actually reaches.

withAgent.title: With an agent
withAgent.detail: Run an agent on the machine hosting the service. The final say over the target address stays with the agent.

withoutAgent.title: Without an agent
withoutAgent.detail: Forward straight to an address; the relay dials it itself. Use this when the device only takes an IP + port.

waiting.title: Waiting for the agent to join…
waiting.hint: This page is watching the event stream and moves on by itself. The long pole is the binary download; just paste the command.
